# 1.1.0
- **Simpler version numbers.** Stenographer's versions now read `major.minor.patch` — this release is 1.1.0 — in the app, the installer, update notices, `steno --version` and `steno health`, which now report the same version. - **Clean upgrades over earlier copies.** The installer now removes earlier Stenographer apps from Applications before installing, including copies built before 1.0, so you are left with one Stenographer instead of two, or one installed inside a folder. It also stops the background service and menu bar app those copies started. - **One password prompt during setup.** Setup steps that need administrator rights now share one prompt instead of asking for your password again for each step. - **The status line turns on when none was set.** Turning on the Claude Code status line no longer fails with "XPCRefusal error 1" when Claude Code had no status line configured. It now fills the empty setting, and when the background service turns a request down, the message says why. - **Your window settings carry over.** Window positions and other settings from Stenographer versions before 1.0 are brought over on upgrade, even when the new version has already saved some settings of its own. Settings you have already changed are never overwritten.

# 1.0.178.0
- **Stenographer 1.0.** Versions now read 1.0.x everywhere you see them — the app, the installer, update notices and `steno --version`. - **Updating from 2.161.0: install this package by hand.** The 2.161.0 updater was misconfigured and cannot install updates, so **Check for Updates…** will not reach this release. Download and run the installer once; automatic updates work from this version on. - **Signed installer and automatic updates.** Stenographer ships as a signed, notarized installer, checks for updates itself (**Check for Updates…** is in the Stenographer menu), and can be installed with Homebrew. - **Setup happens in the app.** On first launch, and after every update, Stenographer installs its Claude Code hooks, background service, plugin and widget itself, with a progress panel. **Manage Stenographer Tools…** in the status menu and the app menu turns the status line and the `steno` command-line tool on or off, and repairs anything that has gone missing. - **Billing for your time in Xcode and other dev apps.** Time spent in the developer apps you choose is recorded and billed per project alongside your Claude sessions, with clients, projects, billable entries and totals in the app. Idle time is cut off after 15 minutes, or a per-project limit you set. Accessibility access is only requested when you turn window tracking on. - **The command-line tool is now `steno`.** It was `stenographer`, then `snog`. The old links are removed and a status line that still uses an old name moves over to `steno statusline`. Saved Claude accounts are managed with `steno claude`, and `steno --version` reports the tool's own version. - **Your data moves with the new name.** Stenographer's data and log folders are now under `com.agenticdevelopmentstudio.stenographer`; existing data is moved there automatically the first time the new version starts. - **One-time keychain prompts for saved Claude logins.** Stenographer now signs as a different app than older source builds did. The first time it reads each login you saved in the login keychain ("This Mac only"), macOS asks whether Stenographer may use it. Choose **Always Allow** and it will not ask again. Logins stored in iCloud Keychain are not affected. - **AI provider keys carry over.** API keys saved by older builds are found and moved automatically instead of appearing blank. - **Windows come back where you left them.** Window positions and the windows you had open survive an update. - **Stopped stays stopped.** If you stopped the daemon from the menu, an update no longer starts it again. - **Installer fixes.** Home folders with spaces in their names, `claude` installed through nvm, Volta, fnm, Bun or a custom npm prefix, and a system HTTP proxy no longer break setup. Hooks run with a real Python rather than the Command Line Tools shim.

# 2.161.0
First packaged release.
- **Install from a signed package.** A notarized `.pkg` installer sets up Stenographer without needing a source checkout. An optional component installs the `claude-account` shell integration (off by default). - **Automatic updates.** Stenographer now checks for updates in the background and offers them from a new **Check for Updates…** menu item. - **Smoother updates.** After installing an update, Stenographer finishes its own setup automatically — no manual steps required. - **The command-line tool is now `snog`.** It replaces `stenographer`; setup moves your status line over to it automatically. - **Burn rate in Account Quotas.** Each account shows how fast it is using its quota, accounts can be reordered, and a seal marks each quota's state. - **Reliable account switching.** Switching Claude accounts no longer loops on password prompts, installs an expired login, or loses a renewed token.
